The mass of a planet is 1 10 th that of the earth and its diameter is half that of the earth. The
acceleration due to gravity on that planet is:
(1)
19.6 m s–2
(2)
9.8 m s–2
(3)
9 m s–2
(4)
92 m s–2
Gravitation
subject: Physics
b6_reason: With one tenth the mass and half the radius, g scales by (1/10) divided by (1/2) squared, that is 0.4, giving about 3.92 m s-2; option 4's damaged text '92' is the only option whose digits can correspond to that value.
b6_note: Both the stem and the options arrived damaged. The mass ratio renders as '1 10 th' with the fraction bar lost, and the option values read '19.6', '9.8', '9' and '92' - the last two have clearly lost leading digits or a decimal point, so no option states 3.92 as written. I have mapped my computed 3.92 m s-2 onto option 4 on the digit match alone and set confidence low; option 3 could equally be a mangled 1.96 or 3.9. The calculation itself is not in doubt, only which label it belongs to.
